Name: (OUTDATED) Sebastian Dialogue Overhaul
Author: casualkira
Description:
About 100 new dialogue options!

It has a dialogue for every day of the week for one year at various heart levels. I did not edit his old dialogue, only added- this is only pre-marriage right now.

Ps everything is canon and gender neutral. I love Seb and tried to capture him as well as possible while also making the dialogue interesting. Of course feedback is appreciated and needed!

NO SMAPI NEEDED! Just replace the old Sebastian.xnb file in your content>characters>dialogue and you're up and running!

PPS this is my first mod so let me know if there are spelling/grammar mistakes/errors.

PPPS ATTENTION: i'm aware of the extraction issue, but I have no idea how to fix it, this is the best I could do to get it posted. sorry if you're unable to download for any reason.
